verdict.rationale: jo is itself a personal AI agent: per its llms.txt it runs on a per-user cloud machine. The docs describe delegating real tasks to it, including scheduled jobs (weekly plans, morning priorities), filing bugs and creating Linear issues, building and publishing websites conversationally, generating decks, and working overnight with its own browser, phone and email. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks actually complete, and in-depth docs on how delegation works and its limits (approvals, failure handling); the current evidence is short vendor snippets.
